```{r}
# filenames
datapath <- "e:/Projects/GPWG/work/feedback/data/"
char_file <- paste(datapath, "GCDv3i/", "v3i_nsa_globe_binboot_nt2kb_pbw10_bw50_200.csv", sep="")
d13C_file <- paste(datapath, "d13C/", "NS_dc13_adjust_lwrboot_span_0.2_200.csv", sep="")
CH4_file <- paste(datapath, "CH4/", "law2006_CH4_lwrboot_span_0.1_200.csv", sep="")
Mann_file <- paste(datapath, "Mann_etal_tmp/", "aaves_tmp_land_lwrboot_hw050_200.csv", sep="")
PAGES2k_file <- paste(datapath, "PAGES2k_tmp/", "PAGES2k_tave_lwrboot_hw050_200.csv", sep="")
```

```{r, results="hide"}
# read data
char_data <- read.csv(char_file); names(char_data)
d13C_data <- read.csv(d13C_file); names(d13C_data)
CH4_data <- read.csv(CH4_file); names(CH4_data)
Mann_data <- read.csv(Mann_file); names(Mann_data)
PAGES2k_data <- read.csv(PAGES2k_file); names(PAGES2k_data)
```

```{r}
# merge data
data_all <- as.data.frame(matrix(NA, nrow=46, ncol=7))
names(data_all) <- c("age", "YearCE", "char", "d13C", "CH4", "Mann_tmp", "PAGES2k_tmp")
data_all[1:3] <- char_data[1:3]
data_all$d13C[1:dim(d13C_data)[1]] <- d13C_data[1:dim(d13C_data)[1], 3]
data_all$CH4[1:dim(CH4_data)[1]] <- CH4_data[1:dim(CH4_data)[1], 3]
data_all$Mann_tmp[1:dim(Mann_data)[1]] <- Mann_data[1:dim(Mann_data)[1], 3]
data_all$PAGES2k_tmp[1:dim(PAGES2k_data)[1]] <- PAGES2k_data[1:dim(PAGES2k_data)[1], 3]
data_all <- data_all[1:41, ]
#print(data_all)
```

```{r}
data_short <- na.exclude(data_all)
```

```{r}
attach(data_short)
plot(Mann_tmp, char, pch=16, cex=0.5)
text(Mann_tmp, char, lab=YearCE, cex=0.7, pos=1)
detach(data_short)
```

```{r}
attach(data_all)
plot(PAGES2k_tmp, char, pch=16, cex=0.5)
text(PAGES2k_tmp, char, lab=YearCE, cex=0.7, pos=1)
detach(data_all)
```
```{r}
data_preind <- data_all[data_all$YearCE < 1750, ]
data_preind_short <- na.exclude(data_preind)
```

```{r}
attach(data_preind_short)
plot(Mann_tmp, char, pch=16, cex=0.5)
text(Mann_tmp, char, lab=YearCE, cex=0.7, pos=4)
detach(data_preind_short)
```
```{r}
attach(data_preind)
plot(PAGES2k_tmp, char, pch=16, cex=0.5)
text(PAGES2k_tmp, char, lab=YearCE, cex=0.7, pos=1)
detach(data_preind)
```
